summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Vivo Clienteling app. Backend: 28/28 pytest tests passed covering auth gating, BI proxy (10 endpoints), notes/tasks/preferences CRUD, templates with manager-only enforcement, messages with consent gating (mock_delivered + 400 on opt-out), public lookbook flow with share_token, audit log, dashboards, and role enforcement (associate gets 403 on /audit, /dashboard/manager, POST /templates). Frontend: All 8 critical pages render successfully — Login, public /share/{token} (no auth), Today (dashboard), Customers, Customer Profile (tabs + send-message/lookbook buttons), Insights (Manager) with recharts KPIs (Net Sales Ksh 80M, Orders 11k), Templates (4 seeded), Audit log table populated with real events.

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer logs 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' warnings on first paint — charts still render correctly after layout settles. Consider giving the parent container an explicit min-height or aspect to silence these warnings.

Console: 'An empty string ("") was passed to the src attribute' — likely user.picture or template image rendered with empty string. Use null/undefined or conditional rendering instead of empty string for src.

action_items: (Optional) Replace empty-string src attributes (likely ) with conditional rendering or src={pic || undefined} in Login/topbar/templates — purely cosmetic console noise.
(Optional) Set min-height on the Recharts ResponsiveContainer wrappers on Manager studio so initial render doesn't log width(-1) warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~860 lines — still readable but approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers per domain (auth, bi, notes_tasks, messaging, lookbooks, dashboards) when adding more features.
_BI_CACHE is an unbounded in-process dict — fine for v1 but will leak memory over time and won't be shared across workers; move to a TTL cache (cachetools) or Redis when scaling.

/api/auth/session uses Emergent's session_token verbatim as the DB session token. If a user re-authenticates, duplicate session_token rows could be inserted. Add a unique index on user_sessions.session_token and upsert on (session_token).

Date/time fields are stored as ISO strings (e.g., sent_at, created_at, expires_at). String comparisons work for ISO 8601 but break if any field is ever stored as a real datetime — recommend standardising on datetime objects in MongoDB and serialising on output only.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI — switch to lifespan handlers.
POST /api/messages does not enforce that the customer_id exists in the BI system — any free-form id is accepted. Acceptable for v1 with mock provider but flag before wiring real BSP.
Public POST /api/public/lookbooks/{share_token}/interest has no rate-limiting or duplicate detection — a public client can spam the interests array.
